classification: Prospectively declared derived diagnostics of already observed capture fits; not an independent capture or holdout; no new audio, download, fit, frequency search or filter design.

mathematics.half_squared_identity: r=(sin(phi)^2+q)/2, q=sin(phi)*abs(sin(phi)); hence mean r=1/4, cosine H2=-1/4, all even H4+ zero, odd coefficients r=q/2.
mathematics.general_gated_identity: For any q(phi+pi)=-q(phi), r(phi)=q(phi) on 0<=phi<pi and 0 otherwise; Fourier odd coefficients r=q/2 without assuming sine, a squared law, or bit widths.
mathematics.common_lti_necessity: For equal pitch and a shared LTI response, constant positive per-wave gains and arbitrary note-on/capture time shifts, normalized odd magnitudes and phase arg(Zn)-n*arg(Z1) must match between q and r. Phase comparisons use principal wrapped difference.
mathematics.unequal_pitch_bound: Using the measured fixed f0s conditionally as exact, if dB response D(f) has |D_prime|<=L over both fundamental and nth-partial intervals, |normalized_dB_r-normalized_dB_q|<=(n+1)*abs(delta_f0)*L. Report the necessary L; impose no physical smoothness bound. Independent frequency-estimation errors, nonstationarity and nonlinearity remain alternatives.

native_probe.operations: Include unchanged actual engine implementation. At all points verify table3 nonnegative, table3=table2^2, table3=(sin^2+table1)/2, and pointwise gated identity. Check numerical Fourier means/coefficient predictions harmonics1..12 within1e-9. No Voice/output render.

derived_capture.selection: All4tables, full and all3equal-third rows, mid channel; this is16 rows from the source-bound already completed audit. Retain all original coefficients, RMS and fit residuals. L/R equality was independently checked by source audit; no stereo replication claim.
derived_capture.odd_comparisons: For table1 and3, every4x4 pair of full/third supports and every odd harmonic3,5,7,9,11:80 diagnostics; arbitrary chronology is not treated as replication.
derived_capture.even_response_comparison: Tables2 versus3 H2 normalized ideal-corrected response, all4x4 supports:16 diagnostics. Means, phase offsets and response cannot be inferred from carrier AC alone.
derived_capture.null_diagnostic: For all16 rows compute Euclidean norm of amplitudes at analytically absent harmonics1..12 divided by norm of all12 amplitudes. This is a partial-coefficient-vector diagnostic, not RMS audio error or a statistical detection threshold.

synthetic_probe.construction: Construct exactly antisymmetric q by concatenating positive first half and its negative; r copies positive half and zeros second half. Compare all odd DFT coefficients r=q/2 before and after a common circular4tap filter [1,0.3,-0.2,0.07]. Compare normalized odd magnitude and phase invariant after per-wave gain and distinct circular shifts. Constants are arbitrary separating test fixtures, never hardware estimates.

no_promotion: No pass/fail gate for hardware-model adoption. All failures and diagnostics retained. No production DSP/default/preset/output/noise/package change.
